# Sector 4

> An explainer-led F1 weekend companion: honest, calibrated podium odds, pit-stop strategy, and the numbers behind a race weekend, with plain-English explanations. Not affiliated with Formula 1, FOM, or the FIA.

Sector 4 pairs grounded predictions with plain-English explanations, and is explicit about where its data is thin rather than sounding falsely confident. Predictions are based on public standings/form and historical telemetry patterns (validated strategy-stop-count signal), not qualifying prediction, betting odds, or live lap-by-lap forecasting.

## Pages

- [Ask](https://sector4.net/ask): natural-language Q&A about podium odds, pit stops, tyre wear, and strategy for the current race weekend.
- [Weekend](https://sector4.net/weekend): this race weekend's frozen podium-odds and strategy predictions, sharpening from Friday to Saturday.
- [Learn](https://sector4.net/learn): a glossary of ~24 hand-authored, cited F1 concept explainers (tyre degradation, DRS, undercut/overcut, safety car, and more).
- [Accuracy](https://sector4.net/accuracy): the season track record — how calibrated the predictions have actually been, updated after every race.

## Notes

- No driver photos, team logos, or betting odds anywhere on the site by design.
- `/learn/[slug]` articles cite external sources (Formula1.com, Wikipedia) per concept.
